Name: Cinderbite Spider
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
This elemental is born from the subterranean magmatic blood pools that form around Cineris Clade. Creatures that die near or in these pools have their life force siphoned off by them, and when enough has accumulated it forms together into this massive spider-like elemental, emerging from the pools and immediately setting about hunting in the surrounding caverns. Some make their way to the Elemental Plane of Fire through fissures that sometimes open in the area, but the majority stalk those same caves indefinitely. Though they do not require food, when they kill and consume a creature, its body and life force are drained away by the blood pools, leading to more of its kind being born.

***Codependency with the Congression.*** These elemental spiders are benign to Dark Elves, who they seem to have recognized as allied to their goals. The Congression have funeral rites that involve burning the bodies of their dead within the blood pools, and it seems that this ritual is what keeps the spiders willing to cooperate with them.

***Elemental Traits.*** The elemental does not require air, food or drink.

**CINDERBITE SPIDER**
*Huge elemental, neutral*
**Armor Class** 15 (natural armor)
**Hit Points** 147 (14d12 + 56)
**Speed** 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
**Quality Traits** Magical, spider climb
**STR** 20 (+5) | **DEX** 16 (+3) | **CON** 19 (+4) | **INT** 5 (-3) | **WIS** 13 (+1) | **CHA** 13 (+1)
**Saving Throws** Con +8
**Skills** Perception +5, Stealth +7
**Immunities** fire, poison
**Condition Immunities** paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
**Senses** blindsight 15 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 15
**Languages** Ignan, understands Undercommon but doesn’t speak it
**Challenge Rating** 9 (5,000 XP) **Prof Bonus** +4

***Illumination.*** The elemental sheds bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light in an 80-foot radius.

**ACTIONS**
***Bite.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (3d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 33 (6d10) fire damage.

***Fire Web (Recharge 5-6).*** A web of flaming threads spreads out from the elemental, entangling each creature it chooses within 30 feet of itself. Each target must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 8d8 fire damage, become restrained, and take 2d8 fire damage at the start of each of their turns while restrained, or half as much on a success. A creature that is restrained by the burning threads can attempt a DC 16 Strength check as an action, escaping the threads on a success. The threads are also immediately destroyed if submerged in liquid or if they take any amount of cold damage.

***Hunting Leap.*** The elemental hurls itself at a creature it can see within 60 feet of it, forcing its target to succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or take 33 (6d10) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The spider ends this movement either in the space of the prone creature, or in an unoccupied space adjacent to it.

**Reactions**
***Detonation.*** A creature the elemental obeys can command it to use this reaction, using their own bonus action to cause the willing elemental to burn brightly and explode. Each creature within 20 feet of the elemental must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. The elemental then dies, leaving behind no trace.
